author: Laura M.
title: Perfect for the Dolomites
text: Wore these boots on a 6 day trek and my feet stayed dry and comfortable. True to size too. Delivery was quicker than promised.

author: Tom R.
title: Tent poles snapped on night one
text: Bought the Ridge 3 tent for a weekend in the Alps. A pole snapped in light wind the first night and we had to pack up at 2am. For a 340 euro tent this is not acceptable.

author: Giulia B.
title: Ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo
text: Scarponi comodi e ben fatti, li uso da due mesi. Unico difetto: la scatola è arrivata un po' ammaccata, ma le scarpe erano perfette.

author: Hannah K.
title: Late and no updates
text: Order took 14 days instead of the 3 to 6 promised. Tracking showed nothing for a week and nobody answered my first email.

author: Peter S.
title: Fast and friendly
text: Wrong size ordered by me, the team swapped it without any fuss. Very helpful.

author: Anonymous
title: Scam
text: I paid and never got anything. This shop is a scam, I have reported it to my bank and I am contacting a lawyer.

author: Marco D.
title: Good jacket, bad checkout
text: The rain jacket is great, warm and light. The checkout kept failing with my card and I had to try four times before it went through.

author: Elena V.
title: Rimborso mai ricevuto
text: Ho restituito le scarpe il 2 settembre e ad oggi nessun rimborso. Ho scritto tre volte, nessuna risposta. Pessimo servizio clienti.

author: James W.
title: Best sleeping bag I have owned
text: Warm down to minus 5 and packs tiny. Worth every euro.

author: Sven L.
title: Reißverschluss kaputt
text: Der Reißverschluss am Rucksack ist nach zwei Wochen kaputt gegangen. Für den Preis hätte ich mehr erwartet.

author: Claire D.
title: Great gear, slow reply
text: Backpack is excellent. Support took four days to answer a simple sizing question, but they were nice about it.

author: Ivan P.
title: My son was injured
text: The stove I bought leaked fuel and flared up while my son was lighting it. He has burns on his hand. This is dangerous and I will report it to the consumer safety authority.

author: Nora T.
title: Lovely boots
text: Bought as a gift and my dad loves them.

author: Carlos G.
title: Cumple, pero caro
text: El saco de dormir es bueno pero el envío costó 15 euros, me pareció excesivo. Producto correcto.

author: Dana F.
title: Charged twice
text: I was charged twice for the same order and only one parcel arrived. Still waiting for the second charge to be reversed after 10 days.

author: Oliver N.
title: Sizing is off
text: The boots run a full size small. The size chart on the site is wrong.

author: Sofia R.
title: Customer service star
text: Had a question about waterproofing, got a detailed answer within an hour. Bought two pairs.

author: Mike A.
title: Not as described
text: The listing said full waterproof but the seams leaked on the first rainy hike. I am writing about this for my hiking blog too.

author: Lea M.
title: Très bon produit
text: Tente solide et facile à monter. La livraison a pris une semaine de plus que prévu mais le produit est top.

author: Greg H.
title: Five stars
text: Great shop, will buy again.

author: Rita C.
title: App keeps crashing
text: The shop app crashes when I open my wishlist. Had to use the website instead.

author: Paul Z.
title: Delete my data
text: I want all my personal data deleted from your systems immediately and a copy of what you hold on me, under GDPR. You ignored my email last week.

author: Anna K.
title: Fine
text: Decent trekking poles. Nothing special, nothing wrong.

author: Ben O.
title: Discount code ignored
text: The 20 percent code was rejected at checkout and support told me it had expired, but your own newsletter says it is valid until the end of the month.

author: Maria L.
title: Perfetto
text: Zaino leggero e resistente, spedizione veloce. Lo consiglio.

author: Chris D.
title: Packaging damaged
text: The tent arrived in a torn box with a ripped bag. Product seems fine but it looked like it had been dropped.

author: Yuki T.
title: Good value
text: Solid gloves for the price. Would like more colours.

author: Sam B.
title: Rude support agent
text: The agent on chat was dismissive and told me it was my fault the boots did not fit. I will tell everyone I know.

author: Emma J.
title: Fast refund, thank you
text: Returned a jacket, refund arrived in five days as promised. Honest shop.

author: Luca F.
title: Spedizione lenta
text: I prodotti sono ottimi ma 9 giorni per ricevere un ordine sono troppi. Con meno attesa sarebbero 5 stelle.

author: Daniel P.
title: Fake reviews?
text: Half the reviews on your site look fake. I bought on that basis and the quality is poor. I am sending this to the advertising regulator.

author: Ruth E.
title: Almost perfect
text: Love the backpack, the hip belt could be softer.

author: Tim G.
title: Overpriced
text: Same stove is 30 euros cheaper elsewhere. Quality is fine, price is not.

author: Isabel S.
title: Excelente
text: Botas cómodas desde el primer día. Entrega en cuatro días.

author: Viktor H.
title: Wrong item twice
text: Received the wrong tent twice. Second time support promised a call back that never came.

author: Joan Q.
title: OK
text: Works as expected. Delivery was a day late.

author: Petra N.
title: Great experience
text: Everything arrived as described and the packaging was recyclable. Nice touch.
